newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy basis offers firms, Nov corn up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy basis offers firms, Nov corn up.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis offers firmed one to two cents a bushel and corn rose in the November positions. Wheat values were steady.
Dealers cited slow farmer sales and expected weather-related harvest delays.
"Farmers are holding onto their beans," one broker said. "They are not selling, plus the forecast of rain in parts of the U.S. Midwest would slow up the harvest."
The same goes for corn, the broker added.
The broker noted that the crop progress report on Monday showed there was still a lot of corn left to be harvested.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture said Monday that 30 percent of the U.S. corn crop had been harvested, compared to 20 percent a week ago and a five-year average of 46 percent.
Export business was said to be quiet.
